metadata.verificationPolicy: Verify provider, eligibility, amount, deadlines and application steps against the provider's official notice before publication. Never invent them.

obligations.note: Bond, service or repayment conditions as stated officially.

dataRules: Every scholarship must have a unique id and slug, and name must be the provider's official name.
Never invent scholarships, providers, amounts, eligibility, deadlines or links; use null when unknown.
Publish a scholarship only from the provider's official notice or website; sourceUrl or officialUrl is required for verification.
awardAmount requires awardCurrency and awardFrequency; amounts are plain numbers as published, never estimated.
Eligibility must be taken from the official notice; eligibilityCriteria entries should each carry a source.
courseIds, institutionIds, stateIds and requiredDocumentIds must reference existing records.
applicationEnd must not precede applicationStart; dates use YYYY-MM-DD or null.
Expired deadlines must be reviewed before display, and closed schemes must not be shown as open.
Never state or imply a scholarship is guaranteed; selection is by the provider.
Never promote or link to anyone charging fees to 'secure' a scholarship; show only the official application channel.
State obligations such as bonds, service conditions or repayment where the notice lists them.
Verified status requires verifiedAt, verifiedBy and a source; verifiedAt and verifiedBy are set together.
scholarshipTypeCatalogue.typicalDocumentIds are indicative only and must not be shown as mandatory for a specific scholarship.
The active field controls display only; it does not mean applications are open.

displayRules.unverifiedLabel: Unverified - confirm eligibility, amount and deadline with the official provider.
displayRules.disclaimer: Scholarships are not guaranteed. Eligibility, amounts and deadlines are set by the provider and can change. Apply only through the official channel and never pay anyone to secure a scholarship.
